character: A high, snow-sure resort on the Radstädter Tauern pass in Salzburg province, where the lifts ring the village so skiers can circle the area in either direction. The terrain lies between about 1,630 m and 2,313 m, and the season usually runs from November into May.
learning: Reference note: ski schools and nursery slopes are in the village; confirm lesson products.
